badge.label: DropViz
cli.auto_draft: No dropviz.yaml found: drafted areas from the folders for a first look (kept in .dropviz/, edit them in Settings).
cli.badge_wrote: wrote {path}. Put this in your README:
cli.connect_backup: the old file was kept as {path}
cli.connect_manual: {tool}: {path} could not be edited safely; add this by hand: {line}
cli.connect_none: No supported AI coding tool found here (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode).
cli.connect_offer: Connect your AI tools ({tools}) so they can read this map? [y/N]
cli.description: See what your AI coding agents actually finished: verified, merged, per feature.
cli.help_areas: comma separated top-level areas, e.g. App,Server,Web
cli.help_badge: write a README badge (SVG, counts only)
cli.help_branch: only records worked on this branch
cli.help_config: read worktree_roots from this yaml instead of the repo's dropviz.yaml
cli.help_configure: show or change areas and the size rule
cli.help_connect: register dropviz as an MCP server in the AI tools found here (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode)
cli.help_kind: what you are building (an app, a game, an OS, a web service)
cli.help_mcp: stdio MCP server for Claude Code and Codex
cli.help_metrics: verified and merged work per day and week, ETA per feature
cli.help_metrics_tokens: also read AI tool records for token counts (slower)
cli.help_since: only records from this date on (YYYY-MM-DD)
cli.help_timelapse: render the history replay (GIF, MP4) or a PNG of the map
cli.help_tokens: tokens per commit and model (counts only)
cli.init_counts: {total} features: {done} done, {prog} in progress, {unk} unknown (default branch: {branch})
cli.init_note: Statuses stay unknown until git shows a merge and a verification record. State folder: .dropviz/ (git-ignored).
cli.not_a_repo: dropviz: {repo} is not a git repository ({err})
cli.question: What are you building? (for example: an app, a game, an OS, a web service; Enter to skip)
err.area_name: every area needs a name (60 characters at most)
err.bad_json: the request was not valid JSON
err.lock: could not lock .dropviz (another dropviz is writing)
err.no_browser: no browser found: install Playwright (pip install playwright, then playwright install chromium) or Chrome
err.no_history: this repo has no history to replay
err.planned: planned must be a whole number from 0 to 5000
err.weight: weight must be a positive number
map.att: commits + assistant asks + page opens (this computer only)
map.risk_red: red CI, or branch idle over 7 days
map.risk_yellow: claim idle over 30 min, or branch idle over 3 days
map.size_features: size = number of features (planned ones included)
map.speed_l: verified items in the last 4 weeks
map.stripe: left stripe = status in every view
mcp.claimed_by: feature {feature} is claimed by session {session} (last active {secs} s ago); pick another with next
mcp.configure_help: Pass areas (nested: name, areas, weight, planned, was for a rename), size_by, work_unit, feature_areas or feature_weights to change the setup.
mcp.configured: Saved. The previous dropviz.yaml was kept as a backup.
mcp.hint_claim: call claim with this feature id before starting
mcp.nothing_next: nothing to pick: every feature is done or claimed by another session
mcp.report_note: Recorded as a claim only. The status becomes done when git shows a merge into the default branch and a verification record exists.
mcp.rule: done = merged to the default branch AND a verification record; claims and reports never change it
mcp.tool_claim: Claim a feature for this session. Refused if another session holds it (claims expire after 2 hours without activity).
mcp.tool_configure: Show or change how the map is organised: the nested area tree (areas hold features and other areas), the size rule (features, weight or work), planned counts and weights. The old dropviz.yaml is kept as a backup. Call without arguments to see the current setup.
mcp.tool_explain: Why a feature has its status: paths, commits, branches, claim, reports.
mcp.tool_metrics: Headline: verified-and-merged work per day and week, plus an ETA per feature (not enough data under 3 weeks of evidence).
mcp.tool_next: The next feature to work on (unmerged work first, then unknown), skipping features another live session has claimed. Includes acceptance criteria.
mcp.tool_report: Record that you believe a feature is done. This does NOT change its status; only a merge and a verification record in git do.
mcp.tool_status: Map summary: counts per status, every feature with its evidence, the area tree, who is working now (tool, model, feature, machine, minutes) and tokens per model. Status comes only from git evidence; unknown means no evidence.
mcp.tool_tokens: Tokens (input, cache read, cache write, output; counts only) per commit, tool and exact model, plus an unattributed bucket. Optional filters.
metrics.eta_rate: {left} item(s) left at {rate} per week (last {weeks} weeks)
metrics.eta_title: Estimate per feature (from the weekly growth of verified items):
metrics.headline: verified and merged: {today} today, {week} this week ({ok} of {total} merged units on {branch} are verified)
metrics.no_target: no target: set the number of items that finish this feature
metrics.none_recent: no verified items in the last {weeks} weeks
metrics.not_enough: not enough data ({have} week(s) with verified items, need {need})
metrics.rule: verified and merged = a commit on the default branch with a verification record at or after it (git note pass, or pass in .dropviz/ci-status.json); unverified merges are listed apart
metrics.tokens_note: token counts only (input + cache + output); empty = tokens not computed
page.counts: {done} done / {prog} in progress / {unk} unknown of {total} features, {planned} planned
page.headline: Verified and merged work
page.headline_text: {week} this week, {today} today. {ok} of {total} merged units have a verification record.
page.models_note: Counts only. Click a model to highlight the features it touched.
page.no_cards: No work found for this feature yet.
page.nobody: No tool is working on this repo right now.
page.pick: Click a feature to see why it has its status.
page.rank_note: Each verified feature is shared among the models that worked on it. Counts only, never money.
page.tokens_split: input {in}, output {out}, cache read {cr}, cache write {cw}
set.areas_help: One word at every level: an area holds features and other areas. Use the arrows to reorder and indent to nest.
set.planned_help: About how many features this area will have in the end
set.rule_features: Number of features (planned ones count too)
set.rule_weight: Weight I set for each area and feature
set.saved: Saved. The old file was kept: {backup}
set.size_rule: What sets the size of the map
set.title: Settings
set.weight_help: How important this area is (bigger = larger on the map)
tokens.none: (no records for this repo in the selected range)
tokens.stats: streamed/copied duplicates merged: {dup}; unreadable files: {unread}; bad lines: {bad}
